metadata.description: Example A SCD Definition: minimal OAC. Two fields. CONN0 is defined by a connector profile and carries no subdividable group, so no protocol_group binding appears. The CID declares only opl_max_w and opl_emg_w, so there is no OPL-SET band and ocp.initial_power_level_set_w is not declared.

fields.description: Logical slot identifier of the position this OAC occupies.
Sustained power the platform can supply to this slot.
